audience: Irish businesses that issue invoices and track payments in Zulu

useCases.title: Find overdue invoices
useCases.text: List the invoices, filtered to the overdue ones. Read the invoice summary for the total outstanding amount.

useCases.title: Check who received an invoice e-mail
useCases.text: List the invoice e-mails with the recipient and delivery status. This tool sends nothing.

useCases.title: Create a draft invoice
useCases.text: Suggest the next invoice number. Then create a draft invoice. The draft is not issued or e-mailed.

useCases.title: Record a bank transfer
useCases.text: Read the invoice, then record the payment against it. The payment cannot be more than the amount due.
